title: Fresh context UI/header overflow is unreadable on mobile
summary: Owner reported the fresh-context UI appeared above screen and was unreadable. Product Development Lead replied that mobile DM header overflow was fixed by constraining the refresh/model action row, stacking below 340px, and applying border-box sizing. The reply reports a rendered regression test (6/6), client tsc -b, Biome, diff checks, and clean 375px phone screenshot; a 250px final live repaint was still outstanding due to an unrelated missing BuddyMemory.css import. Current checkout contains commit 292a7e4, an ancestor of HEAD, implementing a below-placement for header pickers and fixed bottom-sheet placement on mobile. The exact ask appears addressed; no matching current task is recorded.
nextAction: None for this one-off bug report. The reply's 250px live repaint was not evidenced as rerun; reopen if that specific viewport still fails.
evidence: Thread reply post_01a0e6e9-dfdb-74b8-b067-c79300179114 (2026-09-28): implementation details, reported 6/6 channel-dm.test.tsx, client tsc -b, Biome, diff checks, 375px screenshot; notes 250px live repaint remains to rerun after restoring unrelated BuddyMemory.css import.
Commit 292a7e4 is ancestor of HEAD; HarnessPicker requires placement above|below and ChannelComposer.css places below header picker, with mobile fixed bottom-sheet rules.
